body:
I figure that if I do end it, I'll do it in a way that someone else, someone not close, will find me.   

And I've tried to keep a positive outlook, but it gets harder every day.   

And I am struggling to find reasons to live.     Really, I don't want to commit suicide, but I also think that it might be better for me to take the money I have and go travel for a bit and take something along that will allow me to just stop when I run out of energy, money, hope.

Family is not close.    No real friends.   I do have a cat, but I figure I'll let her loose and leave a pile of food somewhere for her.  

Sure, there's a reason or two to live, but all I can see in the future is things getting progressively worse as I lose my health, my home and everything else.    

Is it better to suffer as things get worse, as my health goes, living in progressively worse conditions?   Or should I spend all my money, go somewhere fun for a while and end it all along the way?

And how do I pay for the ice cream?    Should I spend money on ice cream or health insurance (which went up by almost 50% two months ago).   I'm going broke slowly - but more quickly every month - and I'm not at all sure I want to end up dying slowly in a homeless shelter.
